topicHardwareStore.title: Hardware Store
topicHardwareStore.description:
A shop for tools and building materials. Every hardware store sells [lockpicks | gamesLockpick], multi-tools, shovels, flashlights and builder's levels. Many also carry wood, salvaged steel, glass, cloth or leather for [Thinker | topicThinkerMenu] and [Build | topicBuildMenu] recipes.

Each store keeps the same assortment for good. Only the amount on the shelf changes: it is refilled every day.

topicEsotericHeavyParticles.title: Esoteric Heavy Particles
topicEsotericHeavyParticles.description:
The quantum field of magic, or so the theory goes. Every magic user swears they can feel them. Nobody has ever proved they exist.

[CERN | topicCERN] came close. Then its accelerator imploded during the [Y2K Event | topicY2KEvent], and the research was lost with it.

topicCERN.title: CERN
topicCERN.description:
The physics lab under Geneva. After the [Falklands | falklandsWar] it turned its ring to the one physics that paid: [esoteric heavy particles | topicEsotericHeavyParticles], the stuff magic is thought to be made of.

Wizards of the [Guild | magesGuild] and atheist physicists worked the same corridors. They were close to proof when the Hyper Proton Synchrotron imploded during the [Y2K Event | topicY2KEvent]. The team and the research went with it.

squishing.title: The Squishing
squishing.description:
On 21 December 2012 the goddess of discord [Eris | eris] will kill the goddess of justice [Maat | maat] by hurling the [Omega Tower | omegaTower] at her. That has already happened, in the future. What reached us was the echo of the throw, sent twenty years back and across ninety-two dimensions, landing on 21 December 1992 in the sky of dimension three.

The paradox has been fraying the timeline ever since. Spacetime knots itself into local time-loop bubbles (see: [the Rule of 80 | ruleOf80]), and fragments of other dimensions collapse into this one, [the Empty Empire of Varlenia | varlenia] foremost among them. By 2012, when the throw lands for real, the distortion is expected to leave this dimension uninhabitable.

It does not fall evenly. The higher a dimension's number, the faster it unravels: the [Green Fields | topicGreenFields], dimension 77, are already mostly gone. The Omega Tower, driven into the earth by the same throw, is the one thing holding the ninety-two apart.

ruleOf80.title: The Rule of 80
ruleOf80.description:
Since the [Squishing | squishing], the world is dotted with time-loop bubbles. A bubble can be a few metres wide or hundreds of kilometres. Inside one, the day starts over every night.

Anything moving faster than 80 km/h is pulled toward the nearest bubble. The faster it goes, the sooner it is caught. Getting in is easy at any speed. Getting out is the hard part: you must leave faster than 80 km/h. Stay slower and you keep looping.

On a road the pull bends the asphalt itself. A fast driver who stops paying attention ends up somewhere they never meant to go. Bubbles are almost invisible up close, so road maps mark them. There are more every year.

Inside a loop you only die for good if you die above 80 km/h, or are hit by something that fast. Everything else resets. Loopers remember every day, while the world around them forgets.

No call, thought or spell crosses the edge of a bubble. Carrier pigeons with USB drives do: they fly at 90 to 100 km/h, fast enough to break out. That is why [mail | societyMail] travels by bird, and why the [Truckers Society | truckersSociety] exists. Bubba's [liminal engine | liminalEngine] ignores the whole rule.

encompassingRoad.title: The Encompassing Road
encompassingRoad.description:
Every road in every world of the multiverse is, underneath, the same road. Bubba's [liminal engine | liminalEngine] compresses the stretch ahead of a vehicle, and calibrated right it opens onto the Encompassing Road itself, where an ordinary exit can lead to another place, another dimension, another time, or the [Scraps of Creation | scrapsOfCreation].

The road predates every driver on it. Trillions of years ago the concept of a road was born from the God of Asphalt, who paved the first one and became the first victim of a hit-and-run.

magesGuild.title: The Mages Guild
magesGuild.description:
Founded in 950 BC by King Solomon, the Mages Guild kept the world's hidden balance for millennia, until [Margaret Thatcher | ladyThatcher] revealed magic to the whole planet, live, by using it in the [Falklands | falklandsWar]. In the early 1900s [Sir Aleister Crowley | aleisterCrowley] refounded it under the British royal house as a pseudo-chivalric order, which is why its leadership still carries Sir and Lady.

Besides rebuilding lost technology with magic for the world's governments, the Guild exists to defend reality from what the [Squishing | squishing] lets in. Inside it is split into as many currents as there are schools of magic, but every major decision runs through the Three Pillars, who stand for past, present and future. In 2001 the seats belong to Sir Aleister Crowley, Lady Margaret Thatcher and 'the Father', [Shoko Asahara | shokoAsahara].

A Pillar does not age while they hold the seat, and a term runs fifty years. Crowley has never stepped down, and nobody left in the Guild is in a position to make him.

hypercapitalistCollective.title: Hypercapitalist Collective
hypercapitalistCollective.description:
A pyramid scheme the size of a continent, running the trade between dimensions. Its members took the [Rule of 80 | ruleOf80] and made it doctrine: stay above the threshold long enough and the body stops resetting even at a standstill. While the rest of the world loops and forgets, the Collective remembers.

That memory is the business model. They sell escapes to people trapped in loops and trade anything else, memories and emotions included. They also hold every source of clean water left; everything outside their reach is cut with LSD.

At open war with the [Archive Foundation | topicArchiveFoundation], whose radical transparency is bad for a trade empire built on leverage. Allied with the [Gods | theGods].

emTheMemoryWitch.title: Em, the Memory Witch
emTheMemoryWitch.description:
Em was born in 1984 in [Wimbledon | topicWimbledon], Britannia. She wanted to be a witch at a time when magic was only a fairy tale.

[Margaret Thatcher | ladyThatcher], secretly a power in the [Mages Guild | magesGuild], chose her as the focus of the [Solomon Ritual | solomonRitual]. The price was 92% of her memories. They were forged into the Spear of Memory, the weapon that killed the Father aspect of [YHWH | topicYHWH].

Em woke up alone on Ritual Island on 1 January 2001. She has no past she can reach, and a power she is still learning to control. Now she travels with Bubba in the [camper | topicCamper] they share, heading to Beagle for a meeting she barely remembers agreeing to.

camelcaseMagic.title: CamelCase Magic
camelcaseMagic.description:
Since the [Squishing | squishing], every spell must be written and spoken in CamelCase: the words run together, and each one starts with a capital. FireBall works. 'Fire ball' does not, and saying it hurts the caster.

Spells in separate words belong to the gods, and they can reshape reality. When a mortal tries one, the universe sends the bill, starting with the loss of their voice.

[Grimoires | progressGrimoires] show the rule at work. A spell written wrong spreads copies of itself into the words around it. Left unburned, the book eats whatever lies next to it.

A caster takes nine skills into a fight ([The Nine Skill Slots | progressLoadout]). Two known spells can be fused into a new one ([Fusing Spells | progressFusion]).

alagaddaCityOfMasks.title: Alagadda, City of Masks
alagaddaCityOfMasks.description:
[Archive Foundation dossier, incomplete]

Alagadda is on no map. Neither the [Guild | magesGuild] nor the [Archive Foundation | topicArchiveFoundation] has managed to pin it down. Every team sent to find it came back with a different story of how they got in. Some never came back.

One rule never changes. Every visitor wears a mask, and the mask never comes off.

Take it off, even for a moment, and the city stops counting you as a person. The Foundation calls this state Unperson: invisible, untouchable and unable to leave.

The Foundation's advice is short. Mask on. Mask tight. Never take it off.

ruleOfHeight.title: The Rule of Height
ruleOfHeight.description:
Builders tell a story about tall houses. They say that since the Tower fell, the higher you climb, the stranger a building gets: rooms that do not add up, stairs that lead the wrong way.

The cure, they say, is [Fantablack | fantablack] scraped from the [Omega Tower | omegaTower] and mixed into the walls. The skyscrapers rebuilt after the [Y2K Event | topicY2KEvent] are said to have it. Ordinary homes do not.

Nobody has ever proved any of it.

omegaTower.title: The Omega Tower
omegaTower.description:
From outside it looks like a skyscraper that climbs past the sky. It is really a divine spear. [Eris | eris] threw it in 1992 to kill [Maat | maat], the goddess of justice. It went hundreds of kilometres into the ground, and Maat's body lies sealed at its tip.

The Tower pierces all ninety-two dimensions and links them. A mortal can climb it all the way to the celestial throne, where the ruler of the gods sits. Today that is Eris.

It was built as an ark, to carry humanity to another dimension if the world ended. Stuck in the Earth, it can never move again, and it is now the only thing holding the dimensions apart. It stayed sealed until 31 December 1999. That night two billion people died, and its door opened by itself.

Inside is chaos: department stores next to underground jungles, reactors the size of a city, corridors full of tents. Every faction treats it as neutral ground. The [Archive Foundation | topicArchiveFoundation] explored it first and keeps the peace there.

eris.title: Eris
eris.description:
For thousands of years Eris was a third-rate goddess. Bitter, she began to plot her way to the celestial throne. Then, in the early 1990s, she fell madly in love with Bubba, a Neapolitan-Texan mechanic.

They spent years on the road in his old camper, robbing banks along [Route 666 | topicRoute666]. Her power over probability opened any safe. It ended in December 1992. A future Eris killed [Maat | maat], and the present Eris had to go back to chasing the throne, so the paradox would not get worse.

Now she runs the courts of every dimension with no training at all. She judges as she pleases, and she has been worse since Bubba started travelling with [Em | emTheMemoryWitch]. She hates Em, and uses law and luck to make her life hard.

When the Father aspect of [YHWH | topicYHWH] died on 1 January 2001, Eris sat on the empty throne. No other god dared to object.

Commit a crime in front of a witness and you get a bounty ([Crime and Bounty | lawCrime]). In her court you can plead guilty, plead not guilty, or accuse Eris herself and fight her for the throne ([The Trial | lawTrial]).

theGods.title: The Gods
theGods.description:
The gods are at open war with the [Mages Guild | magesGuild], whom they suspect of preparing another [Solomon Ritual | solomonRitual]. A god exists in proportion to how many people still believe in it, which is why so few from antiquity are left.

A god that dies of neglect turns to stone and falls into the [White Desert | topicWhiteDesert], and nobody minds. Deicide is different: the body stays anchored to physical reality and rots, with the consciousness still awake inside it. [Maat | maat] is one recent case, pierced by the [Omega Tower | omegaTower] and buried hundreds of kilometres down. The Father aspect of [YHWH | topicYHWH] is another: his body still orbits the Earth in the debris the [Kessler Syndrome | kesslerSyndrome] set loose. Every impact knocks another piece off the corpse, and it is those pieces that fall. Whoever touches one takes a share of his power, enough to grant abilities to someone who cannot cast a spell.

scrapsOfCreation.title: The Scraps of Creation
scrapsOfCreation.description: Small pocket dimensions the gods once used, eons ago, to test their powers and their creativity. They stayed sealed off until the [Squishing | squishing]: after 1992 some began falling into the physical world on their own, and others became reachable for the first time through Bubba's [liminal engine | liminalEngine].

liminalEngine.title: The Liminal Engine
liminalEngine.description:
Bubba's own invention. Switched on, it squeezes the road ahead of the vehicle, so crossing a continent takes minutes.

It also ignores the [Rule of 80 | ruleOf80]. It slips between dimensions instead of racing past the limit, so no time-loop bubble can pull it in, at any speed. Its one weakness is getting close to a bubble: driven too near a bubble, the chassis splits apart along its seams. Liminal routes are planned to keep clear of every bubble on the map.

The first prototype ran in 1996. It went into production in 2001, and now nearly every public transport vehicle on Earth has one. It made Bubba disgustingly rich.

Tuned right, it can take a vehicle underwater, into the air or into space. Only Bubba knows the setting that opens a way to other dimensions.

naguka.title: The Naguka
naguka.description:
Tens of millions of years ago a common ancestor of Homo sapiens moved permanently underground, into the cave system [Magamui | magamui] had dug ages before. The Naguka evolved alongside surface humans and stayed human enough to interbreed with them; the hybrids are called orcs.

In May 1970 Soviet engineers drilled too deep with the Kola Superdeep Borehole, and the Naguka climbed back up it. Campaigning through Scandinavia in the 1990s they discovered Norwegian black metal, and much of the tribe took to worshipping the band [Junehem | junehem] as gods, painting their faces with corpse paint before battle.

The [Holy Vatican Empire | vaticanEmpire] is the only hyperpower with formal ties to them, and its missionary work is really an attempt to raise a standing army.

Every Naguka shares the [Goblin collective unconscious | goblinHorde]. Hurt one and the species turns against you.

verden.title: The Verden
verden.description:
They look much like the [Naguka | naguka], gentler featured, skin with a blue tint. But where the Naguka are human at heart, the Verden are true goblins, evolved in another dimension, with a biology to match: they lay eggs, reproduce by fission, and a severed limb planted in soil grows into a new Verden.

They once lived in the [Green Fields | topicGreenFields], dimension 77, among the most advanced species in the multiverse, until for reasons nobody now knows they gave up all their technology, launched it into their home star, and settled into a bucolic life studying magic. Driven out by the [Squishing | squishing], they found a new home on Earth and fell in love with its technology in turn. Most are well integrated and speak fluent MarkovSpeak, unlike their Naguka cousins, who still talk like children.

Having studied the Naguka, they learned to read the [Goblin collective unconscious | goblinHorde] and see their moves coming. The access is read-only: they cannot plant anything in it.

junehem.title: Junehem
junehem.description:
A Norwegian black metal band on its way to becoming gods. Millions of [Naguka | naguka] worship them. Through their music they steer the Goblin collective unconscious, and they lead the [Goblin Horde | goblinHorde] pushing into Europe from Scandinavia.

Count Grissnack's voice is the one the goblins hear loudest. [Hieronymus | hieronymus] is the member who walked away.

Every government on Earth has tried to kill them. A god of metal cannot die while a single goblin still believes, and millions do.

hieronymus.title: Hieronymus
hieronymus.description:
A former member of [Junehem | junehem]. His bandmate Count Grissnack stabbed him, and he survived. The brain injury gave him savant syndrome and made him one of the strongest psionics alive.

The rest of the band live as gods. Hieronymus quit music instead, and the [Horde | goblinHorde] has never quite forgiven him.

Nobody knows where he is. There is no address and no contact, and even the [Guild | magesGuild]'s scryers cannot find him. Some say a monastery, some say another dimension. The likeliest answer is duller: he is somewhere quiet, left alone at last.

petrodemons.title: Petrodemons
petrodemons.description:
Entities made of sentient crude oil, effectively indestructible while near a [leyline | topicLeylines], which keeps regenerating them. Dinosaurs, so the theory goes, were natural [arcane practitioners | arcaneMagic] able to cast without leylines, and some of that power stayed bound to the oil their bodies became.

The only way to kill one is to break the leyline it draws on first, and even then it takes an army.

Most hyperpowers would rather sign contracts than fight. Petrodemons can redirect leylines, and that is worth more than the win.

matteiLegend.title: The Legend of Enrico Mattei
matteiLegend.description:
The story goes that Enrico Mattei, founder of ENI, found a scroll in a Libyan tomb holding the ritual to summon and bind [Petrodemons | petrodemons]. He is said to have attempted it to win Italy full energy independence, and something went wrong: his plane went down in 1962.

Whether the Petrodemons are real or not, the story has stuck as the tidiest metaphor going for the oil industry.

kesslerSyndrome.title: The Kessler Syndrome
kesslerSyndrome.description:
During the [Y2K Event | topicY2KEvent] the ENVISAT satellite lost control and hit another one. The debris has kept smashing into more satellites ever since. Within a year the belt was so thick that leaving Earth became close to suicide. Crossing it is like walking through a meat grinder.

The European Space Agency, led by [Margherita Hack | topicMargheritaHack], fires its rockets from giant coilguns, wrapped in armour plates. The belt tears the plates off one by one, and what is left comes out the top. These flights cannot leave the solar system. They only carry the crew up to dock with a starship waiting above the debris.

Flights leave from the [Greenwitch Space Center | topicGreenwitchSpaceCenter] and the [Apulia Space Center | topicApuliaSpaceCenter]. A seat up to the starship costs 500 euros.

The belt has one strange gift. The corpse of the Father aspect of [YHWH | topicYHWH] orbits inside it. Every hit knocks off another piece, and pieces of a dead god fall to the ground.

canadafrica.title: Canadafrica
canadafrica.description: One of the first visible effects of the [Squishing | squishing]. Over a single day the whole of Mexico and South America reshaped itself to match the outline of Africa seen from space, cities, borders and all their people left exactly where they were.

serpentineRoad.title: The Serpentine Road
serpentineRoad.description: A spiralling tunnel opening somewhere in Antarctica, connecting the surface to the Earth's core and to the [Inverted Citadel | invertedCitadel]. [Magamui | magamui] dug it hundreds of millions of years ago on its way down.

magamui.title: Magamui
magamui.description:
An alien larva a quarter the size of the Moon, wrapped around the Earth's core for millions of years, feeding on the heat and electromagnetism it produces.

Dormant as it is, it can still take mental control of one person at a time, mostly to keep itself safe. There is reason to think that would extend to the whole human population at full maturity, and that its leaving the Earth would be catastrophic.

Part of the [Mages Guild | magesGuild]'s job is finding whoever is currently under its control and killing them, since taking a new host costs Magamui time it would rather not spend.

invertedCitadel.title: The Inverted Citadel
invertedCitadel.description:
Built inside a vast cavern [Magamui | magamui] carved around the Earth's core, with the core hanging at the centre like a sun. The city wraps entirely around it, so looking straight up shows other districts on the far side.

It was raised by an advanced civilization that lived on Earth somewhere between the dinosaurs and humanity, and vanished without leaving a written record or a scrap of technology, just an empty city. It became the underground capital of the [Goblins | goblinHorde].

vaticanEmpire.title: The Holy Vatican Empire
vaticanEmpire.description:
A Catholic theocracy and the heir of the Holy Roman Empire. It rules Italy, Spain and much of Catholic Europe. The Pope holds the empire together, while each member state runs its own local government.

Only [sacred magic | sacredMagic] and technomancy are allowed. Arcane casters are burned at the stake. A few are recruited instead into the [Umbra Excidii | topicUmbraExcidii], the order that hunts other arcane casters on Vatican soil.

The Pope is [Petrus II | popePetrusII], born Joseph Ratzinger. He was elected after John Paul II was killed in the assassination attempt of 13 May 1981.

Vatican City runs on a set of [liminal engines | liminalEngine]. After the death of the Father aspect of [YHWH | topicYHWH] it became the Vatican Citadel. It floats about 800 metres above Rome, guarded by Gauss cannons. Petrus II has declared [Jenna of Northpoint | jennaOfNorthpoint] the Antichrist and is at war with her.

okeanus.title: Okeanus
okeanus.description:
The ultimate water spell, the one that traumatized the planet live on television during the [Falklands War | falklandsWar]. It lets the caster control an entire mass of water at once, and it was used to annihilate the Argentine fleet, swallowing ships whole and cutting men in half with pressurized jets.

Its use revealed to the world that magic was real, and set off an arms race in battle magic among every hyperpower on Earth.

theonuclearBombingNewYork.title: The Theonuclear Bombing of New York
theonuclearBombingNewYork.description:
On 11 September 2001 a Thatcherist cell detonated three theonuclear devices in the heart of New York. The blasts did almost no structural damage. They disintegrated every soul within their radius, leaving the bodies still moving on instinct and biology with nothing inside them.

The attack was blamed on Al-Qaeda. Only the [Three Pillars | magesGuild] know that the bombs were built from artifacts consumed by the [Solomon Ritual | solomonRitual], their spent potential turned into a weapon instead of discarded.

solomonRitual.title: The Solomon Ritual
solomonRitual.description:
A rite that lasts a whole night. It needs the Three Pillars of the [Mages Guild | magesGuild], one sacrifice, and seven artifacts of great historical or magical weight. Each artifact used loses all its power. The power it never spent can be turned into a [theonuclear device | theonuclearBombingNewYork].

It was last performed on the night of 31 December 2000. Six of the seven artifacts are known: the Iron Crown of the Holy Roman Emperors, the Spear of Longinus, the Norse sword Tyrfing, clay from the Golem of Prague, the dragon clasp of Xia, and a Neolithic bone horn.

The ritual rewrites the rules of magic in its dimension. It can make magic easy for anyone, limit it to a chosen few, or switch it off. Magic stayed a fairy tale for centuries because so few could use it. [Crowley | aleisterCrowley] found the ritual again in the early 1900s and quietly opened magic to everyone.

The 2001 ritual had another goal. It drained the memories and the future of [Em | emTheMemoryWitch], who volunteered as the sacrifice, and forged them into a spear that could kill the Father aspect of [YHWH | topicYHWH]. Em survived. She lost 92% of her memories, and came out far more powerful than before. Nobody knows why.

Smaller versions use one artifact instead of seven. Their effects fade, and the caster risks death or memory loss every time.

fantablack.title: Fantablack
fantablack.description:
A pigment scraped from the outer skin of the [Omega Tower | omegaTower]. Anything painted with it is immune to [time-loop bubbles | ruleOf80], and every vehicle fitted with a [liminal engine | liminalEngine] is lined with it. It is expensive, and bullets and blades coated in it can kill a person inside a loop.

The same pigment is milled into euro banknotes, which, with the rule that names carry power, is what let [Mario Draghi | marioDraghi] ascend to godhood.

anokiPhones.title: Anoki Phones
anokiPhones.description:
The first working example of technology rebuilt through magic. The bricks draw on [leylines | topicLeylines] to reach each other, and tuned properly they can call the afterlife, or the gods directly.

No [trucker | truckersSociety] leaves home without one.

arcaneMagic.title: Arcane Magic
arcaneMagic.description:
Magic bends reality to the caster's will. Nobody can explain it neatly: the more it is studied, the less sense it makes. A few rules always hold, and [CamelCase | camelcaseMagic] is the first of them.

Magic flows along [leylines | topicLeylines], invisible rivers of power that rise from oil deposits. Near a leyline spells are stronger but harder to control. An untrained caster standing right on one can break it, and where a leyline is broken even a simple spell is a struggle. Far from any leyline spells still work, only weaker. [Sacred magic | sacredMagic] follows rules of its own.

There are three ways to cast.

Ritual magic: follow every step without a mistake. Anyone sensible can do it. It is the strongest kind and the hardest to undo.

Sympathetic magic: words, gestures and catalysts squeeze a ritual into seconds. It is faster and weaker, and it costs MP.

Metamagic: pure imagination replaces everything physical. It is silent, cast by thought alone, and the weakest of the three. People often mistake it for psionics, which is not magic at all.

sacredMagic.title: Sacred Magic
sacredMagic.description:
Where [arcane magic | arcaneMagic] rises out of oil deposits and runs along [leylines | topicLeylines], sacred magic comes down from the gods, granted to whoever worships and calls on them.

It shares the three casting methods, ritual, sympathetic and meta, but can also take the form of outright miracles with no explanation at all, violating every rule everything else has to follow.

It stops working the moment its god dies. Most of the sacred spells the [Vatican | vaticanEmpire] relied on have been useless since 1 January 2001.

truckersSociety.title: The Truckers Society
truckersSociety.description:
The real knights of the [Road | encompassingRoad]. They haul cargo between communities that live in different realities, and often they are the only link left between them.

They have their own ranks and their own network for passing on news of the road ahead. Never turn down road news from a trucker.

None of them leave home without an old [Anoki phone | anokiPhones].

marioDraghi.title: Mario Draghi
marioDraghi.description:
Mario Draghi's name is printed on tens of billions of euro notes. It appears in more transactions than God's name appears in every Bible on Earth.

The security strip of every note holds [Fantablack | fantablack] scraped off the [Omega Tower | omegaTower], and names carry power. On the last night of 2000 Draghi left his body behind and rose as the god of markets. He is no longer a person. He is the engine that quietly runs the economy of the multiverse.

Other gods die when belief runs out. To kill Draghi you would have to burn every note that carries his name.

ladyThatcher.title: Lady Margaret Thatcher
ladyThatcher.description:
Prime Minister of [Britannia | topicBritannia], and the pillar of the present in the [Mages Guild | magesGuild]. She was deep inside the Guild long before the [Falklands War | falklandsWar], where she drowned the Argentine fleet with [Okeanus | okeanus] in front of the cameras.

When the Guild needed someone to sacrifice in the [Solomon Ritual | solomonRitual], she picked [Em | emTheMemoryWitch]. She had taken the girl in years before and taught her real magic. It was never kindness. She was shaping Em for the ritual.

Things did not go to plan. Em lost ninety-two percent of her memories but came out far more powerful than before, and learned metamagic on her own. Thatcher now watches her old student with unease rather than pride.

aleisterCrowley.title: Sir Aleister Crowley
aleisterCrowley.description:
Crowley refounded the [Mages Guild | magesGuild] in the early 1900s as a knightly order, backed by the royal house of [Britannia | topicBritannia]. That is why its leaders are still called Sir and Lady. He has held the seat of the past ever since and refuses to step down. Nobody can make him. He knows spells even the gods have never heard of.

In April 1900 he tried to seize the Golden Dawn's vault by force and was thrown down the stairs at [Blythe Road | blytheRoadBattle]. What he called up afterwards has been redacted from every record.

In 1918 he summoned Lam, one of the [Tourists | theTourists]. The spell only worked one way, and Lam is still stuck on Earth.

A pillar does not age, but Crowley's body is wearing out anyway. Everyone knows he needs a new one, and nobody knows what he plans to become.

shokoAsahara.title: The Father, Shoko Asahara
shokoAsahara.description:
One of the three pillars of the [Mages Guild | magesGuild]: he holds the seat of the future. Before that he led a cult behind one of the deadliest terror attacks in living memory.

Inside the Guild he is known as a master of levitation. Nobody doubts his power, only his methods.

His seat is the Guild's most disputed choice. Nobody outside the inner circle knows why a mass murderer was given a say over the future of magic. [Crowley | aleisterCrowley] despises him and does not hide it.

blytheRoadBattle.title: The Battle of Blythe Road
blytheRoadBattle.description:
On 17 April 1900 the poet W. B. Yeats stood on the stairs at 36 Blythe Road, London. A young occultist in Highland tartan, a black mask and a golden Celtic cross tried to get past him. It was [Aleister Crowley | aleisterCrowley], come to seize the Golden Dawn's vault by force.

Yeats did not argue. He and two other Adepti threw Crowley down the stairs. The police came, nobody was charged, and Crowley was barred from the Order.

Every surviving account stops at the bottom of the stairs, at the moment Crowley got back up. What happened next has been redacted ever since, and nobody admits to knowing whose hand did it.

theTourists.title: The Tourists
theTourists.description:
The Tourists is what the Zeta Reticulans call themselves. Everyone else calls them Greys. Their home is thirty-nine light years away, so Earth's first broadcasts reached them in 1975. Official first contact came in 1999.

They love humanity, and above all its television. On one of their worlds stands the Monument to Humanity, a huge tribute to our species that you can visit. They mean nobody here any harm.

What they are good at is spacetime: travel faster than light, gravity, and two working Dyson spheres around their twin stars. A flight to Zeta Reticuli tops up its fuel from the spheres on the way in.

Outside of that they are close to hopeless. They lean on human science and magic for everything else, and keep failing to clear the [Kessler | kesslerSyndrome] debris around Earth.

theDargos.title: The Dargos
theDargos.description:
The Dargos come from Titania, a world far out in Andromeda. The [Tourists | theTourists] are recent arrivals. The Dargos have known about Earth for a very long time.

Their contact with humans is mostly abductions and pranks, cruel and precise enough that official reports call it trolling. Even their embassy is run as one long joke at humanity's expense. It attends no assembly and answers no summons.

They seem to want nothing but the reaction. A victim is rarely hurt for long, and is rarely believed. Many researchers think that is the whole point.

hillIncident.title: The Hill Incident
hillIncident.description:
On the night of 19 September 1961 Betty and Barney Hill were driving home through the White Mountains. A craft forced their car to stop. Both of them lost almost two hours they could never explain.

It became the first famous abduction case, and Betty's sketch of a star map is still argued over.

Every published account misses one detail. The craft never got home. On its way back to Zeta Reticuli it was shot down by the wards [Crowley | aleisterCrowley] had laid around Earth, and its report was never sent. The [Tourists | theTourists] only learned Earth existed fourteen years later, over the radio.

zanfrettaIncident.title: The Zanfretta Incident
zanfrettaIncident.description:
On 6 December 1978 Pier Fortunato Zanfretta was working a quiet night shift as a security guard outside Genoa. That night he had his first encounter. It was not the last.

For years he kept reporting new visits. With every retelling the beings grew taller, stranger and harder to believe.

[Guild | magesGuild] researchers now treat it as a running joke rather than a single event, and they blame the [Dargos | theDargos]. Nothing in the case looks like real contact. All of it looks like a species that found a gullible, camera-friendly man and kept coming back to hear what he would say next.

jennaOfNorthpoint.title: Jenna of Northpoint
jennaOfNorthpoint.description:
Jenna of Northpoint claims to be the Second Coming, and enough people believe her that the claim carries real weight. Belief keeps a god alive in this world, and hers has the numbers.

In December 2001 she raised the Northpoint Army over Greenland. She says it has no enemies, only a standing army, and that she took the ice to end war. She preaches a militant kind of pacifism.

[Pope Petrus II | popePetrusII] has declared her the Antichrist and taken the [Holy Vatican Empire | vaticanEmpire] to war over her claim. Jenna has not answered in kind. She lets his war make her case for her.

popePetrusII.title: Pope Petrus II
popePetrusII.description:
Born Joseph Ratzinger. He became Pope Petrus II after John Paul II died from the assassination attempt of 13 May 1981. His predecessor is remembered as protected by destiny. Petrus II is remembered as the pope who armed it.

After the Father aspect of [YHWH | topicYHWH] died in 2001, he had Vatican City rebuilt as the Vatican Citadel. It floats about 800 metres over Rome, guarded by a battery of Gauss cannons.

He has declared [Jenna of Northpoint | jennaOfNorthpoint] the Antichrist and taken the [Holy Vatican Empire | vaticanEmpire] to war against her.

maat.title: Maat
maat.description:
The Egyptian goddess of justice, order and truth. She weighs the hearts of the dead against a single feather. She outlived the slow loss of her worshippers better than most [gods | theGods] of her age.

Then [Eris | eris] killed her by throwing the [Omega Tower | omegaTower] at her. Eris does it in December 2012, but the blow landed in 1992. That murder is where [the Squishing | squishing] began.

Maat's body lies under the Tower's tip, hundreds of kilometres below the ground. Her mind is still awake inside a corpse that cannot move and cannot die again. Nobody has found a way to free her that would not make the paradox worse.

falklandsWar.title: The Falklands War
falklandsWar.description:
A small colonial quarrel over a few islands that few people outside Argentina and [Britannia | topicBritannia] cared about. Then [Margaret Thatcher | ladyThatcher] stepped in front of the cameras and cast [Okeanus | okeanus]. Live, with the whole planet watching, she drowned the Argentine fleet under a wall of water.

That broadcast is how the world learned magic was real. Governments that had denied it for decades scrambled to catch up. The arms race in battle magic that followed began with those few minutes of footage.

varlenia.title: The Empty Empire of Varlenia
varlenia.description:
A nation from another dimension, and one of the first places [the Squishing | squishing] dropped into this world. It now sits in the Atlantic as an island, west of Ireland, and appears on every map.

Its land is here. Its people are not. Not a single Varlenian has been seen, and nobody knows where they went or whether they will follow.

That is why everyone calls it the Empty Empire. Nothing there attacks. Nothing there does anything at all, and the silence gets into people who stay too long.

threeAmericas.title: The Three Americas
threeAmericas.description:
Independence never fully happened here, and the continent split three ways.

The Free States of Midwest hold the centre, a free confederation with Bill Clinton as president. The Cascadia Protectorate holds the west coast as a crown protectorate of [Britannia | topicBritannia]. The Eastern Seaboard holds the east coast, a punitive colony aligned with Britannia and run by George W. Bush.

The three barely acknowledge each other. What they share travels the roads between them, on [Route 666 | topicRoute666], carried by the same [truckers | truckersSociety] who carry everything else.

goblinHorde.title: The Goblin Horde
goblinHorde.description:
What the [Naguka | naguka] became once they had a government. It is a warband confederacy. Its head is simply the Big Boss, its clans argue in Da Moot, and a boss lasts only until somebody bigger shows up.

The goblins climbed out of the Kola Superdeep Borehole in May 1970. Today the Horde holds Norway and Iceland, and wants the rest. It has the biggest army on Earth and almost no economy.

The Horde does not do diplomacy so much as raids that sometimes stop. The only power with formal relations is the [Holy Vatican Empire | vaticanEmpire], whose missionaries keep trying to convert a people that mostly wants to be left alone with its [Junehem | junehem] records.

kukulkanAscendancy.title: The Kukulkan Ascendancy
kukulkanAscendancy.description:
Mexico's hyperpower calls itself a restoration, not a republic. Its head of state is the God-Emperor, after Kukulkan, the feathered serpent. Its council, the Council of Ajawob, spends most of its time arguing about the calendar. Each reign runs for one k'atun, about twenty years.

Yet its record of leaders reads like Mexico's own century: Porfirio Diaz, Madero, Zapata, Villa, Cardenas and on to Zedillo. Nobody in the Ascendancy finds this strange. Whether Kukulkan still sits behind the modern presidency is not a question its citizens ask.

dprkorea.title: The Democratic People's Republic of Korea
dprkorea.description:
The Kim family runs the Democratic People's Republic of Korea the way it always has, from father to son to grandson. The head of state is the Eternal Chairman. A small fixed bench of party men handles whatever the family does not.

The Supreme People's Assembly has two parties, and one of them has never won anything.

From outside, the politics are hard to read. What is easy to see is the personality cult. State media claims impossible things about the Kims, like weather control and effortless victory, so steadily that it stops sounding like propaganda and starts sounding like a claim.

dharmaDirectorate.title: The Dharma Directorate
dharmaDirectorate.description:
China's government wears two faces at once and does not see the seam.

One face is familiar. Its record of leaders runs through Sun Yat-sen, Chiang Kai-shek, Mao, Deng and Jiang Zemin, as history remembers them.

The other face is a harmonious empire of rites and examinations. Its head is the Chancellor of Rites. Its assembly is the Hall of Ten Thousand Voices. Nobody votes on the mandate to rule: a body of twenty-five Preceptors reviews it, like an exam.

Which face runs the country on a given day depends on who you ask. The Directorate has never seen a reason to explain it to outsiders.

illuminatedKhanate.title: The Illuminated Khanate
illuminatedKhanate.description:
Mongolia is a khanate run out of a monastery. Its ruler is the Illuminated Khan. Nobody elects the Khan: the abbots of the Gandan Order recognise him. The old line of Bogd Khans stands behind the throne, and the Steppe Banners ride for it.

By army, money or people it is a small hyperpower. It stays one through its monks, who treat spellcraft as prayer and prayer as a discipline nobody else has mastered half as well.

solomonicRepublic.title: The Solomonic Republic
solomonicRepublic.description:
Israel's government is a republic bound to the seventy-two spirits King Solomon sealed. Its head of state is the Nasi of the Republic, and its assembly is the Restored Sanhedrin, which argues Goetic precedent in every session.

Its officials carry spirit names and ranks out of the old grimoires, a Prince Sitri here, a Duke Beleth there. They were given office instead of being exorcised, and they still serve under a contract three thousand years old.

The Clerks of the Divided Name keep the brass vessels sealed. They insist that nothing is currently missing.

petroKingdomOfArabia.title: The Petro Kingdom of Arabia
petroKingdomOfArabia.description:
Arabia's monarchy runs on what lies under it. Its ruler is the Oil-Emir, its council is the Concession Majlis, and the throne has passed down the House of Saud, from Ibn Saud to his sons.

The titles do not mention that some of the oil talks back. [Petrodemons | petrodemons] lie thick under Arabian sand. The Kingdom's Deep Contractors bargain with whatever the drilling wakes, and much of its foreign policy rests on those contracts, signed with things older than the monarchy.

sanatanaRashtra.title: Sanatana Rashtra
sanatanaRashtra.description:
India is a dharmic republic: a parliament that sits under an acharya, a spiritual teacher. Its Prime Ministers include Nehru, Indira Gandhi and Vajpayee. Its assembly, the Rashtra Sabha, votes on what tradition turns out to have required.

It is the one hyperpower that never split its magic from its government. The Matha Circle, its teaching houses, quietly runs whatever the assembly forgets. Its view is simple: a state without dharma is not a state worth keeping.

longChile.title: Long Chile
longChile.description:
Chile calls itself the Long South. It is the thinnest country in the world, and the one most convinced it ought to be longer. Every election is about the next valley.

Its head of state is the President-Marshal, and its assembly is the Congress of the Long South. Its record of leaders runs through Ibanez, Alessandri and Pinochet.

The military never really left politics. The Cordillera Corps guards a border that is mostly vertical and never quite where the map puts it.

imperialStatePersia.title: The Imperial State of Persia
imperialStatePersia.description:
In Persia the revolution never came. The Qajar shahs handed over cleanly to the Pahlavis: Reza Shah, Mohammad Reza, then Reza Pahlavi II. Mossadegh's time as premier is filed as an interruption, not a break. Shahbanu Farah appears in the record as more than a consort.

The Peacock Throne appoints a Prime Minister, and the government answers to the National Consultative Assembly. The Immortal Guard protects the Shah.

The Imperial State treats its own survival as its main export. A monarchy, it says, only falls when it agrees to.

topicApuliaSpaceCenter.title: Apulia Space Center
topicApuliaSpaceCenter.description:
A [coilgun | galaxyRocketLaunch] launch pad near Taranto, on the heel of Italy, beside a steelworks whose four chimneys burn all night. With [Greenwitch Space Center | topicGreenwitchSpaceCenter] it is one of the two pads on Earth's ground.

Rounds come down here from Greenwitch on a short hop, and from the [starship | galaxyShip] and the Moon. Since the [Kessler | kesslerSyndrome] cascade nobody flies for fun. The crews are volunteers, and the queue is short.

topicArchiveMenu.title: The Archive
topicArchiveMenu.description:
The Help entry of the [main menu | topicMainMenu], in its Archive group. It is the book the party relearns the road from.

It holds the manual, the states, the [elements | elementsOverview], the [diseases | healthDiseases] and the [history of the century | societyHistory]. Its [Topics | societyTopics] page lists everything someone has told the party, this page included. Once one member has heard a topic, any of them can bring it up in conversation.

topicArchiveFoundation.title: The Archive Foundation
topicArchiveFoundation.description:
Paramilitary librarians who grew out of the ashes of the Internet Archive. They want to catalogue everything and publish all of it. Their leader is the First Archivist.

They hold the [Omega Tower | omegaTower] as neutral ground between the hyperpowers, and they chair [the Assembly | peopleONU] that meets inside it. Bubba swears they would stop you at a checkpoint just to publish your phone messages.

topicBritannia.title: Britannia
topicBritannia.description:
The successor to the British Empire, a parliamentary monarchy with [Margaret Thatcher | ladyThatcher] as Prime Minister.

Its royal house backed [Sir Aleister Crowley | aleisterCrowley] when he refounded the [Mages Guild | magesGuild] as a knightly order in the early 1900s. That is where the Guild's Sir and Lady still come from.

Across the ocean it holds the Cascadia Protectorate on the west coast of [the three Americas | threeAmericas], and the Eastern Seaboard is aligned with it.

topicBuildMenu.title: Build
topicBuildMenu.description:
The Build menu opens the furniture builder on the map you are standing on.

You can buy furniture, or make it from materials such as wood, salvaged steel, cloth and glass. Then you place it on the floor, piece by piece. Taking a piece apart gives back most of its materials.

You cannot build on the [world map | worldMapPage]. Building on land somebody else owns is a crime, and the value of what you built is added to your [bounty | lawCrime]. See [Building and Furniture | craftFurniture].

topicCamp.title: Camp
topicCamp.description:
Make a camp on the [world map | worldMapPage]: press [Continue | topicContinue] and choose Make a camp, or just wait there. You can also camp from the menu of a [vehicle | vehiclesOverview] you are standing by, but never in the air.

A camp costs nothing, and on most of the [Encompassing Road | encompassingRoad] it is the only bed going. A night there does more than a bed. The party washes and talks, so [hygiene | needsHygiene] and [company | needsSocial] come back too. If food is running low, a pot goes on the fire and the party eats from the [backpack | gearBackpack].

topicCamper.title: The Camper
topicCamper.description: Bubba's battered [home on wheels | vehicleCamper]: lined inside with [Fantablack | fantablack] so the [time loops | ruleOf80] cannot touch it, and fitted with the only [liminal engine | liminalEngine] calibrated for the [Encompassing Road | encompassingRoad]. Three people have tried to steal it and none of them managed to drive it.

topicCedrataMassoni.title: Cedrata Massoni
topicCedrataMassoni.description:
A cloudy yellow citron soda. [Em | emTheMemoryWitch]'s taste for it survived the loss of almost everything else she was. The first time Bubba told her about the [menu | topicMainMenu], she asked whether it served Cedrata Massoni.

You will not find it in any shop or vending machine. For now it exists only in Em's memory.

topicContinue.title: Continue
topicContinue.description:
Continue is the confirm button.

Press it next to a person or an animal to see what you can do with them, such as [Empathize | topicEmpathize]. Press it next to an object to use it.

On the [world map | worldMapPage] it opens the travel choices: visit the square, [forage | needsForage] it, or make a [Camp | topicCamp].

topicCookingMenu.title: Cooking
topicCookingMenu.description:
The Cooking option of the [main menu | topicMainMenu] turns raw ingredients into meals.

The pot combines two foods into one better meal. The [Recipes | craftCooking] page makes proper dishes, which go into the [backpack | gearBackpack] for later. Each dish needs a cooking level. If you are below it, the dish may come out spoiled and make whoever eats it sick. You are warned before cooking anything a party member is allergic to.

Cooked food feeds you better than raw ingredients. See [Hunger and Nutrition | needsHunger].

topicCrimsonAnalyzers.title: The Crimson Analyzers
topicCrimsonAnalyzers.description: The scientific caste of the [Tourists | theTourists], who hold that nothing is understood until it has been opened, and who carry katanas because a scalpel is slow and the universe is large. In 1999 they wanted [Em | emTheMemoryWitch] vivisected, lacked the permit, and left her to wander their ship instead.

topicEmpathize.title: Empathize
topicEmpathize.description: The [Empathize panel | peopleEmpathize]: read a person or an animal, talk them round, and if they warm to the party, ask them along, as a [pet | partyPets] or as a [member | partyRecruiting] in their own right.

topicEsotericHeavyIndustries.title: Esoteric Heavy Industries
topicEsotericHeavyIndustries.description:
A faction that, by Bubba's account, makes everything from fusion reactors to technomagical gear. Their goods are said to ignore the [Rule of 80 | ruleOf80]: move an EHI object slower than eighty and it still does not reset.

Nobody has ever seen one of their factories or workers. The stock simply appears in the warehouse when nobody is looking.

topicGiulioAndreotti.title: Giulio Andreotti
topicGiulioAndreotti.description: The Italian politician [Em | emTheMemoryWitch] found aboard a [Tourist | theTourists] mothership over [Roccalonga | topicRoccalonga] on the night of the [Y2K event | topicY2KEvent], deep in conversation with [Marco Marco Marco | topicMarcoMarcoMarco]. Nobody has explained what either of them was doing up there.

topicGreenFields.title: The Green Fields
topicGreenFields.description: Dimension 77, home of the [Verden | verden] and once one of the most advanced worlds in the multiverse, until they threw every machine they had into their own star and took up farming. [The Squishing | squishing] bites hardest at the higher dimensions, and the Green Fields are already mostly unlivable.

topicGreenwitchSpaceCenter.title: Greenwitch Space Center
topicGreenwitchSpaceCenter.description:
One of the two places that will take the party up through the debris belt. The other is the [Apulia Space Center | topicApuliaSpaceCenter]. Greenwitch stands in [Britain | topicBritannia], by London.

A [coilgun | galaxyRocketLaunch] a kilometre tall throws an armoured round into the sky. The [Kessler belt | kesslerSyndrome] tears the armour off plate by plate, and what is left docks with the party's [starship | galaxyShip].

A flight to orbit costs 500 euros. The short hop to Apulia is free. In story mode every flight is free.

topicJudicialDimension.title: The Judicial Dimension
topicJudicialDimension.description:
Where [Eris | eris] holds her [trials | lawTrial]. Bubba says judicial ghosts drag the guilty here. She runs billions of trials at once, so do not expect her full attention.

Before the hearing you can hire a lawyer, let a companion speak, or defend yourself. Then you plead: guilty, not guilty, or it is complicated. You can also tell her she is the guilty one, which only annoys her.

The last choice is to challenge Eris to a fight. Lose the case and the party goes to [prison | lawPrison].

topicLeylines.title: Leylines
topicLeylines.description:
Invisible rivers of [arcane | arcaneMagic] power. They rise from oil wells and link places of historical, religious or arcane weight.

Mages say a spell cast near one is stronger but harder to hold. Standing right on one without training can break it. Where a leyline is broken you can barely light a candle by magic.

topicMainMenu.title: The Main Menu
topicMainMenu.description:
Not a physical menu. As Bubba puts it, you just picture a JRPG menu in your head. Press MENU to open it.

From here the party reaches the [Thinker | topicThinkerMenu], [Build | topicBuildMenu], [Research | topicResearchMenu], [Cooking | topicCookingMenu], Wait for [sleep | topicSleepMenu], the [Help book | topicArchiveMenu] and everything else.

topicMarcoMarcoMarco.title: Marco Marco Marco
topicMarcoMarcoMarco.description: A [Tourist | theTourists], found arguing with [Giulio Andreotti | topicGiulioAndreotti] aboard the mothership that took [Em | emTheMemoryWitch] over [Roccalonga | topicRoccalonga] on the last night of 1999.

topicMargheritaHack.title: Margherita Hack
topicMargheritaHack.description: The astrophysicist running the European Space Agency. Her answer to the [Kessler cascade | kesslerSyndrome] is rockets built almost entirely out of sacrificial armour plating, meant to be shredded on the way up and to arrive anyway.

topicMoonlitStation.title: Moonlit Station
topicMoonlitStation.description: A roadside stop by a lake in Belgium, and the last ordinary evening the party had. There was a New Year's Eve picnic and homemade technomagical fireworks. Then a giant hand made of water rose out of the lake and took [Em | emTheMemoryWitch] with it.

topicNobelPrize.title: The Nobel Prize
topicNobelPrize.description: The Swedish committee that handed Bubba one of its prizes, and that [Em | emTheMemoryWitch]'s father, by Bubba's account, bribed in its entirety to get the Em Drive past peer review.

topicOverviewEffect.title: The Overview Effect
topicOverviewEffect.description: What takes hold of a person who sees the whole Earth at once from orbit. It reportedly declines to visit billionaires. Nobody has explained that convincingly.

topicPet.title: Pet
topicPet.description:
The [Empathize | topicEmpathize] option for animals. Petting never goes wrong, and each time the animal likes you a little more.

An animal that likes you is more likely to say yes when you ask it to come along. It can follow the party as a [pet | partyPets], or join as a full member if a party slot is free.

topicResearchMenu.title: Research
topicResearchMenu.description: The Research menu: stockpiled materials spent on [discoveries | worldTechTree]. What one party works out belongs to the whole world it was worked out in, not to a single savegame.

topicRoccalonga.title: Roccalonga
topicRoccalonga.description: A rural Italian village, and the place a triangular mothership set down on the night of the [Y2K event | topicY2KEvent] while Bubba and [Em | emTheMemoryWitch] were hunting [aliens | theTourists] there. They took Em to study her, and then gave her back.

topicRoute666.title: Route 666
topicRoute666.description: The highway running the length of all [three Americas | threeAmericas]. Bubba did most of his growing up on it, and most of his bank robberies with [Eris | eris].

topicSleepMenu.title: Sleep
topicSleepMenu.description:
Beds, campfires, tents, a [camp | topicCamp] on the [world map | worldMapPage] and [rented rooms | econProperty] all let the party [sleep | needsSleep]. Choose how long, up to twelve hours.

Eight hours is a full night: health, magic and stamina come back, and states and broken bones heal. Wait in the main menu can also sleep rough where you stand. That is worth only half a night, unless you carry bedding.

topicThinkerMenu.title: The Thinker
topicThinkerMenu.description:
The [workbench | craftThinker] in the [main menu | topicMainMenu]. One screen holds every recipe for items, weapons and armour, made from materials like salvaged steel and wood.

Recipes the party has not [trained | progressTraining] for yet are listed but greyed out. The same bench can also take an item apart for its materials. Food is made in [Cooking | topicCookingMenu] instead.

topicUmbraExcidii.title: The Umbra Excidii
topicUmbraExcidii.description: The [Holy Vatican Empire | vaticanEmpire]'s arcane corps, whose job is hunting [arcane practitioners | arcaneMagic] on imperial soil. Arcane magic carries the stake in the Empire, so the Empire found the one loophole in its own law and staffed it.

topicWhiteDesert.title: The White Desert
topicWhiteDesert.description: Where a [god | theGods] goes when the belief runs out: the body turns to stone and drops, and nobody much minds. The desert is made of the ones who starved, lying where they landed.

topicWimbledon.title: Wimbledon
topicWimbledon.description: The London suburb where [Em | emTheMemoryWitch] was born and where her father lives. He invented the Em Drive she was named after. Bubba insists he bribed every peer reviewer and the whole [Nobel Prize | topicNobelPrize] committee to get it accepted.

topicY2KEvent.title: The Y2K Event
topicY2KEvent.description: The night of 31 December 1999, when two billion people died and nobody has explained how. The same night the [Omega Tower | omegaTower]'s sealed door opened by itself, like a coin machine that had finally counted enough coins, and the ENVISAT satellite lost control and started the [Kessler cascade | kesslerSyndrome].

topicYHWH.title: YHWH
topicYHWH.description:
The Abrahamic [god | theGods]. [Em | emTheMemoryWitch] killed his Father aspect with a lance forged out of her own memories. That death left the celestial throne empty, and [Eris | eris] sat in it.

What is left of him orbits the Earth, sandblasted by [satellite debris | kesslerSyndrome]. Pieces of him fall back down, and whoever picks one up gains a share of his divine power.

topicArmy.title: Army
topicArmy.description:
Up to a hundred [troops | societyArmy], hired at an [inn | worldHouses] with Recruit troops. Each one costs a fee to hire. They follow the party on the [world map | worldMapPage] and fight its field battles as one block, not as party members.

Each troop also has a weekly wage. If the party's money could not cover a week of it, their morale drops.

topicOptionsMenu.title: Options
topicOptionsMenu.description: Where everything about how the game looks, sounds and answers to a [controller | controlsGamepad] is set: text size, the retro shader, the [battle music | hypernetMusic], the tooltips, and every key the party is steered with.

topicFriday.title: Friday
topicFriday.description:
The day of the week [Em | emTheMemoryWitch] forgot for months, after one of her [spell fusions | progressFusion] went wrong. It was one of the small memories she lost long before the big one.

Friday is odd in the sky too. On a Friday, Earth has three moons on the [star map | galaxyOverview] instead of one.

topicMahyem.title: Mahyem
topicMahyem.description: A black metal band out of Norway that the [Naguka | naguka] goblin hordes worship as literal [gods | theGods]. Belief keeps them alive: every government on the planet has tried to kill them and none has managed it. Their music steers the [goblin collective unconscious | goblinHorde], and the hordes marching down through Scandinavia into Europe march to it.

topicEuronymous.title: Euronymous
topicEuronymous.description: The member of [Mahyem | topicMahyem] who survived Varg's knife. The brain trauma left him with acquired savant syndrome and one of the most powerful psionic minds alive. He walked away from the stage while the rest of the band went on living as gods, and nobody knows where he is now.

topicTritunnelWest.title: Tritunnel West
topicTritunnelWest.description: The western mouth of the Tritunnel, the bored crossing that runs under the sea between [Britain | topicBritannia] and the continent. Drive the [Camper | topicCamper] south far enough and the road goes underground here; the far end opens in Belgium.

topicHypermetroTrain.title: The Hypermetro
topicHypermetroTrain.description: A train that runs through tunnels which are not always where they were yesterday. It is the quick way to anywhere worth going, including the [Omega Tower | omegaTower], and for some places it is the only lifeline to the rest of the world.

topicEsotericShop.title: Esoteric Shop
topicEsotericShop.description:
A [shop | econShops] of occult curiosities: charms, scrolls, amulets, crystal balls, spellbooks, old occult books and monster parts. The shelf changes every day.

An empty spellbook, a candle and The Lesser Key of Solomon are always in stock. Now and then a rare [artifact | gearArtifacts] turns up too. Plenty of the stock is fake, and the labels admit it. For potions and a flying [broomstick | topicBroomstick], try a Magic Shop.

topicBroomstick.title: Broomstick
topicBroomstick.description:
A flying [broom | vehicleBroom]. Every Magic Shop keeps one on the shelf, for about 600 euros, and a garage may stock one too.

[Em | emTheMemoryWitch]'s last one was broken, along with several of her bones, when a [Tourists | theTourists] arc ship ran her over.
